tool_args.rationale: The seven readings show a smooth rising concave response in u_now and distinct gradient-branch shifts. A numerically fitted saturating-plus-square-root response with a gradient-dependent slope captures these features using a compact model; the global fit state also ensures predict(row) can use the parameters produced by fit(train_rows).

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its two branch readings reveal gradient-dependent variation, so another branch probe is not needed before fitting.
The observations are smooth and monotone-concave without evidence that trajectory resolution is the limiting ambiguity.
The observed response continues rising through u_now=3.5 rather than dropping at high input.
A single multiplicative power law does not naturally capture the observed saturating/concave shape plus the opposing gradient-branch effects.
